key.name: enabled
key.description: Master switch. When off, no border is ever drawn.

key.name: follow-focus
key.description: When on, the border follows any focus change, including mouse clicks and alt-tab. When off, it is drawn only for focus changes requested by the gnome_window_controller commands over D-Bus.

key.name: color
key.description: Any CSS color St accepts, for example #993c5a or rgba(0,0,0,0.5).

key.name: width
key.description: Thickness of the border drawn around the focused window.

key.name: inset
key.description: How far outside the window frame the border sits.

key.name: duration-ms
key.description: How long the border stays up. Zero keeps it until focus moves away.

key.name: fade-ms
key.description: Length of the fade used when the visible duration expires.

key.name: skip-maximized
key.description: Do not highlight windows that are maximized both horizontally and vertically.

key.name: only-normal
key.description: Restrict highlighting to normal toplevel windows, skipping dialogs and popups.

key.name: config-migrated
key.description: Internal flag. Set once the pre-GSettings highlight.json has been imported.
